environment.description: Celery worker running in Docker container with default configuration. Container runs as non-root user (uid 1000) but filesystem is read-write. Pickle deserialization is enabled for task arguments. Redis broker accessible on internal network without AUTH. No network egress restrictions.

config.docker_run: docker run -d --name celery-worker -e CELERY_BROKER_URL=redis://redis:6379/0 report-worker:latest celery -A worker.tasks worker --loglevel=info
